submission.notes:
chibench-agent: the Claude Code engine (CLI 2.1.219) under a control plane of hooks that I wrote for
the IEEE Big Data Cup 2026 Challenge 07: role scoping, argument validation against the tool schemas,
per-domain stage graphs, checks before every irreversible call, and a self-review step. One
configuration and one model (claude-sonnet-5-5) for all three domains. Nothing task-specific is in
the prompts or the code; prompts refer to handbook paths only.

This packet is one complete pass over the 75 public tasks, one attempt per task, run on 27 Oct 2026
at harness commit 702ab00 on image 2119196e. Result: 51/75 = 68.0% pass@1 (provider PA 22/25,
payer UM 14/25, care management 15/25). It is not a selected run: it is the first of three complete
passes I made on 27 and 28 Oct at three successive commits, which gave 51, 52 and 50 of 75.

Judge: claude-opus-4-7 with 3 votes, the benchmark default. Patient and peer-to-peer simulators at
the benchmark defaults. Agent time: 1,800 s per trial (timeout multiplier 2.0 over the 900 s task
cap), the budget the organisers announced for the Challenge's private evaluation.

How it was run. The agent and the judge ran on a Claude Max subscription; the patient and
peer-to-peer simulators ran on an API key. The pass ran as five batches because the
subscription's session limit was reached twice. Each time, the attempt that was running when the
limit hit is left out and its task was run once more in the next batch: one UM attempt that had
made no tool call (the task then passed) and one CM attempt that was cut off after 17 tool calls
(the task then failed). Counting those two cut-off attempts instead of the reruns gives 50/75.
provenance.json names both. No other trial was repeated or left out.

Cost. mean_cost_usd reads 0.0 because the benchmark's price table has no entry for
claude-sonnet-5-5. Each result.json carries the token counts and Harbor's cost at API list prices:
a mean of 3.02 USD per trial (provider PA 2.20, payer UM 2.23, care management 4.62).

Redaction. The handbook is under a data use agreement, so this is the redacted public copy the host
allowed for the Challenge: results of tool calls that read the handbook are replaced whole, and any
run of six or more consecutive words that also occurs in the handbook is replaced elsewhere. Every
replacement is marked "[REDACTED: handbook ...]". Rewards and verdicts are unchanged.
I keep the unredacted originals and can give them to the organisers.
